record.long_description: The Purdy 144662091 White Dove roller cover is a 9-inch roller with a 1/4-inch nap. Its core is made from 075 phenolic resin, which Purdy believes is among the strongest and most solvent resistant cores on the market, giving it resistance to solvents. The cover is wound with a spiral seam, a construction Purdy calls an exclusive, which the maker says allows smooth rolling with no swerving or fishtailing. Purdy also takes care to keep the bevel precise and even, which it says eliminates tracking. The result is intended to be a steady, even roll during application. These performance claims come from the manufacturer's listing, so check the product details to confirm the cover suits your project and coating type before you buy.

record.seo_title: HBCY Creations Rustic Torched Wood Magnetic Chalkboard
record.meta_description: Shop the HBCY Creations 11 x 17 inch rustic torched wood magnetic wall chalkboard. Solid pine frame, magnetic writing surface, and flexible hanging options.
record.long_description: Bring a rustic touch to your kitchen, store, restaurant, or wedding display with this framed wall chalkboard from HBCY Creations. The frame is made from solid Russian pine and finished in a torched wood color for a modern yet classic look. The outer frame measures 11 by 17 inches and the writing area measures 9.5 by 15.5 inches, a size suited to signs, menus, short announcements, and home memo boards. The surface is magnetic porcelain steel, so you can write with traditional chalk or chalk markers and attach pictures, notes, and lists with magnets. Hanging hardware is inlaid in the frame for vertical or horizontal use, and wall anchors, screws, and a mini level are included. The set also comes with an eraser and a box of chalk to get you started. To clean, wipe away writing with a damp cloth and let dry, with no special cleaning solution needed. Each board is handcrafted, so color and distressing may vary slightly.

record.meta_description: Rustic farmhouse coffee table with a lift top, four smooth-gliding drawers and casters. Brown and black finish, 46 inches wide, assembly required.
record.long_description: This Signature Design by Ashley coffee table blends farmhouse character with traditional styling, making it a fitting centerpiece for a living room with a rustic or classic look. The brown and black finish pairs with dark bronze-tone hardware for a cohesive, grounded appearance. A lift top rises to create a workstation surface, so you can work, write, or set up a laptop without leaving the room. Beneath the top, four drawers glide smoothly and offer space for keepsakes, remotes, and everyday items. Casters on the base make it simple to reposition the table when you clean or rearrange the room. Assembly is required, and the package includes easy-to-follow instructions and all the hardware needed for setup.

record.description: A brow pencil with an oval tip designed to resemble natural hair strokes. Its universal medium brown shade adapts to different hair colors depending on how firmly it is pressed. The smudge-resistant formula is meant to keep brows looking natural through the day, and a built-in spoolie brush helps blend the line.
record.seo_title: It Cosmetics Super Skinny Brow Power Pencil
record.meta_description: Shop the It Cosmetics Super Skinny Brow Power Pencil in universal medium brown. Its budge-proof, oval-tip formula mimics real hair and includes a spoolie brush.
record.long_description: Brow Power Super Skinny is a pencil built for defining and filling in brows with a fine, hair-like look. Its oval tip is shaped to mimic individual strands, so strokes look more like real brow hair than a blunt pencil line. The universal medium brown shade is designed to work across many hair colors, with the depth of color controlled by how much pressure you apply. The formula is described as budge-proof, meaning it adheres to the skin to help brows look natural and stay put. The pencil is also said to help cover gray hairs. Enriched with biotin, saw palmetto, and antioxidants, it is positioned as a brow-enhancing product. A built-in spoolie brush lets you brush and soften the color after application for a polished finish. This award-winning brow pencil is made to suit a wide range of hair colors, from very light blonde to deep brunette, in one shade.

record.long_description: This charcoal steel storage unit from Lorell combines drawers and flipper doors in one compact cabinet measuring 48 by 24 inches. A durable laminate top provides a sturdy work surface, and its radius edges make it more comfortable to rest your arms on while working. Each leg includes two knockouts, which can be opened to run cables between connected desks, helping keep wiring tidy and out of the way. The neutral charcoal finish suits a range of office settings. It is a practical choice for organizing files, supplies, and personal items beneath or beside a desk while keeping the workspace efficient and orderly.

record.description: Refurbished DJI Inspire 2 professional drone for filmmakers, offering 5.2K recording, dual-battery flight endurance, two-direction obstacle sensing, and intelligent flight modes including Spotlight Pro.
record.seo_title: DJI Inspire 2 Drone (Renewed)
record.meta_description: Renewed DJI Inspire 2 drone for filmmakers with 5.2K CinemaDNG RAW video, up to 27-minute flight time and Spotlight Pro flight modes.
record.long_description: This renewed DJI Inspire 2 is a professional drone built for filmmakers and camera operators. Its image processing system records up to 5.2K video in CinemaDNG RAW and Apple ProRes formats, and it works with 5.2K gimbal cameras. Speed is a highlight: the aircraft accelerates from 0 to 50 mph in about four seconds and reaches a top speed of 67 mph. A dual battery system extends flight time to a maximum of 27 minutes when used with an X4S camera, and self-heating technology helps it fly in low temperatures. Obstacle avoidance covers two directions, with sensor redundancy built into the flight system. Intelligent flight modes, including Spotlight Pro, let a single pilot capture complex, dramatic shots. An upgraded transmission system streams the onboard FPV camera and main camera at the same time, supporting collaboration between pilot and camera operator. This unit is sold as renewed.

record.description: Six flameless LED votive candles that run on batteries and need no flame. A remote control sets one of four automatic timers and works from up to 20 feet away. Their wax-like bodies and soft flickering warm-white light resemble real candles, suiting parties, weddings, and holidays.
record.seo_title: Flameless LED Votive Candles with Remote Timer, Set of 6
record.meta_description: Set of six battery-operated flameless LED votive candles with a remote, four-timer settings and a warm, flickering glow for home, weddings and parties.
record.long_description: These flameless votive candles bring a soft, flickering glow to rooms without any open flame, so they can be used safely around children and pets. Each candle has built-in daily timers for 4, 5, 6 and 8 hours. Choose the setting with the remote control, and the candles switch on and off automatically every day. The remote works from up to 20 feet away, which makes it easy to adjust candles placed on high shelves, chandeliers, or sconces. The wax-like bodies have drip details, and the warm white LED bulbs flicker to resemble real candles. Batteries are included. The set suits everyday home decor as well as kitchen tables, gardens, and seasonal events such as weddings, baptisms, parties, Halloween, and Christmas. They also work inside pumpkins or lanterns.
